hypotheses.reasoning: auth-svc lost an instance (liveness restart, capacity 3/4). account-svc then retried POST /tokens immediately with backoff disabled (4 attempts), driving auth-svc to 3-5x baseline load. auth-svc kept shedding 503s, and that kept the retry storm going, so /login did not recover. The edge-proxy 503s are the downstream symptom. status-poller timeouts against the deprecated legacy-inventory endpoint, the catalog S3 retry quota exhaustion, and the search-api 500s look unrelated.
auth-svc was over capacity with 713-752 requests in flight, but the overload came from retry amplification.

verdict.recommendedAction: Re-enable exponential backoff with jitter in account-svc's AuthClient, and cap its retries. Restore auth-svc capacity and investigate why auth-svc-3 failed its liveness probe. Temporarily throttle /login at the edge so auth-svc can drain its queue.
